cards.ex: You absolutely nailed that presentation! Everyone was impressed.
cards.exUz: Siz o'sha taqdimotni juda zo'r qildingiz! Hamma hayratda qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Bir ishni juda yaxshi bajarmoq, muvaffaqiyatga erishmoq.

cards.ex: I have to give kudos to the team for their hard work on this project.
cards.exUz: Men bu loyiha ustida qattiq mehnat qilgan jamoaga maqtov aytishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir yaxshi ishi uchun maqtamoq, minnatdorchilik bildirmoq.

cards.ex: I appreciate your constructive criticism; it will help me improve.
cards.exUz: Men sizning konstruktiv tanqidingizni qadrlayman; bu menga yaxshilanishga yordam beradi.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshilanishga yordam beradigan, foydali tanqid.

cards.ex: She deserves a pat on the back for her outstanding performance.
cards.exUz: U ajoyib ishlashi uchun rag'batlantirishga loyiq.
cards.uzDef: Maqtov, minnatdorchilik, rag'batlantirish belgisi.

cards.ex: Unfortunately, our sales figures fell short of expectations this quarter.
cards.exUz: Afsuski, bu chorakdagi savdo ko'rsatkichlarimiz kutilgan darajaga yetmadi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan darajaga yetishmaslik, kamchilikka yo'l qo'ymoq.

cards.ex: He tends to pick apart everyone's ideas in the meeting.
cards.exUz: U yig'ilishda har kimning fikrlarini tanqid qilishga moyil.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir yoki kimnidir mayda-chuyda qilib tanqid qilmoq.

cards.ex: The product has a major flaw in its design, making it unusable.
cards.exUz: Mahsulotning dizaynida katta kamchilik bor, bu uni ishlatib bo'lmaydigan qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta, muhim kamchilik.

cards.ex: There's always room for improvement, even in the best projects.
cards.exUz: Hatto eng yaxshi loyihalarda ham har doim yaxshilanish imkoniyati mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan sohalar mavjudligi.

cards.ex: You're on the right track with this plan; just keep refining it.
cards.exUz: Siz bu reja bilan to'g'ri yo'ldasiz; uni takomillashtirishda davom eting.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri yo'lda ekanlik, muvaffaqiyatga erishish ehtimoli yuqori.

cards.ex: The team delivered a stellar performance, exceeding all expectations.
cards.exUz: Jamoa ajoyib natija ko'rsatdi, barcha kutgandan ham oshib ketdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaxshi, a'lo darajada bajarilgan ish.

cards.ex: His presentation was okay, but he could do better with more preparation.
cards.exUz: Uning taqdimoti yaxshi edi, lekin ko'proq tayyorgarlik bilan yaxshiroq qila olardi.
cards.uzDef: Yana ham yaxshiroq qilish imkoniyati bor edi.

cards.ex: The restaurant received a glowing review in the local newspaper.
cards.exUz: Restoran mahalliy gazetada juda yaxshi baho oldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda ijobiy, maqtab yozilgan taqriz.

cards.ex: The comedian found it hard to make the audience laugh; it was a tough crowd.
cards.exUz: Komik uchun tomoshabinlarni kuldirish qiyin bo'ldi; bu talabchan olomon edi.
cards.uzDef: Qoniqtirish qiyin bo'lgan, tanqidga moyil odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: The advertisement completely missed the mark and failed to attract customers.
cards.exUz: Reklama umuman maqsadga erisha olmadi va mijozlarni jalb qila olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erisha olmaslik, xato qilmoq.

cards.ex: Our new employee is really on the ball; she learns quickly.
cards.exUz: Bizning yangi xodimimiz juda tez harakat qiladi; u tez o'rganadi.
cards.uzDef: Tezkor, aqlli va samarali harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: His work has been below par lately; he needs to improve his performance.
cards.exUz: Uning ishi oxirgi paytlarda o'rtachadan past bo'ldi; u o'z ko'rsatkichlarini yaxshilashi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'rtacha darajadan past, talablarga javob bermaydigan.

cards.ex: Her dedication to the project is a shining example for the rest of the team.
cards.exUz: Uning loyihaga sodiqligi jamoaning qolgan a'zolari uchun yorqin misol.
cards.uzDef: Ajoyib, namuna bo'ladigan misol.

cards.ex: He only got a slap on the wrist for his minor mistake.
cards.exUz: U kichik xatosi uchun faqat ogohlantirish oldi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik jazo, ogohlantirish.

cards.ex: The movie didn't quite live up to the hype.
cards.exUz: Kino umidlarni to'liq oqlamadi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan standartlarga yoki umidlarga mos kelmoq.

cards.ex: That sounds like a backhanded compliment; are you saying I'm old?
cards.exUz: Bu ikki ma'noli maqtovga o'xshaydi; siz meni qari deb aytyapsizmi?
cards.uzDef: Maqtovga o'xshagan, lekin aslida tanqid bo'lgan gap.

cards.ex: The team exceeded expectations with their innovative solution.
cards.exUz: Jamoa o'zlarining innovatsion yechimlari bilan kutganidan oshdi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilgan natijalardan yuqori natijalarga erishmoq.

cards.ex: The play received harsh criticism from the critics.
cards.exUz: Pyesa tanqidchilar tomonidan qattiq tanqidga uchradi.
cards.uzDef: Juda qattiq, achchiq tanqid.

cards.ex: You're doing a great job, keep up the good work!
cards.exUz: Siz ajoyib ish qilyapsiz, yaxshi ishlashda davom eting!
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi ishni davom ettirishni so'rash.

cards.ex: Stop nit-picking; focus on the bigger picture.
cards.exUz: Maydachilikni to'xtating; katta maqsadga e'tibor qarating.
cards.uzDef: Faqat mayda kamchiliklarni topishga urinish.

cards.ex: Her talent made her stand out from the other applicants.
cards.exUz: Uning iste'dodi uni boshqa arizachilardan ajralib turishiga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalardan ajralib turmoq, diqqatga sazovor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: I really dropped the ball on that project; I'm so sorry.
cards.exUz: Men bu loyihada katta xato qildim; juda afsusdaman.
cards.uzDef: Xato qilmoq, vazifani bajara olmaslik.

cards.ex: I feel underappreciated at my job; my efforts go unnoticed.
cards.exUz: Men o'z ishimda qadrsizlanayotganimni his qilyapman; mening harakatlarim sezilmaydi.
cards.uzDef: Qilingan ish uchun yetarlicha qadrlanmaslik.

cards.ex: He needs to get a grip and stop panicking about the deadline.
cards.exUz: U o'zini bosib, muddat haqida vahima qilishni to'xtatishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z hissiyotlaringni nazorat qilmoq, tinchlanmoq.

cards.ex: Everyone needs to pull their weight to finish this project on time.
cards.exUz: Bu loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun har bir kishi o'z hissasini qo'shishi kerak.
cards.uzDef: O'z qismini bajarmoq, guruhga teng hissa qo'shmoq.

cards.ex: His performance was a tough act to follow; no one could match his energy.
cards.exUz: Uning ijrosi shunchalik zo'r ediki, uni takrorlash qiyin edi; hech kim uning energiyasiga mos kela olmadi.
cards.uzDef: Shunchalik yaxshi ishlangan ishki, uni takrorlash qiyin.
